purpose: Separate an application-specific Tauri window failure from the current macOS GUI observation/session boundary before changing native lifecycle code.
observations: A clean isolated build with Tauri 2.11.5, tao 0.35.3 and wry 0.55.1 compiled successfully and was launched with isolated data and port 18768; the process stayed alive, sidecar health was valid, and System Events still reported visible=true with count of windows=0.
The same isolated upgraded binary with an explicit Regular activation policy still reported zero windows, so a speculative activation-policy workaround was not carried into the product worktree.

The installed legacy /Applications/dzmm.app and the native Calculator control app also stayed alive with System Events visible=true and count of windows=0 in this observation session; the screenshot window enumerator listed ChatGPT, system UI and control surfaces but no Calculator or DZMM window.
All temporary upgraded, legacy and control processes were stopped after the check; no isolated sidecar process or test port was left running.
assessment: The current host cannot provide reliable visual WindowServer evidence for a newly launched app, even with a Tauri upgrade and a non-DZMM native control app. The macOS package gate remains unpassed, but the root cause is not proven to be DZMM code.

Do not add a native lifecycle hack or claim the DMG is fixed from this session. The next valid gate requires a macOS session where a known control app produces an observable window, then rerun the DZMM DMG A-F journey there.
not_proven: Whether the upgraded Tauri stack opens a window in a normal local macOS GUI session.
Whether the current DMG opens a window on macOS 14 or 15 or on another macOS 26 session.
Windows native and Android physical-device package journeys remain unrun.
